general_information.Description: This course covers the fundamentals of working in CG (Computer Graphic) with Maya. It’s only a starting point, though. As with any artistic pursuit, CG is a lifelong process of learning. With what you learn in this course forming a solid foundation, you can continue exploring all the complex, interesting facets of creating CG imagery
general_information.StudentTasks: Attendance: The course content and assigments are closely tied together; excessive absences will severely and negatively affect the learning process. Any student who misses 20% classes will fail the course. Assigments: You are given weekly assignments that are completed during the week. Assignments are evaluated against a set of technical criteria as well as on aesthetic quality. Late assignments will result in an automatic lowering of the grade. Attendance at each class and lab is expected. Missing classes or late arrival will result in a lowered grade. Plagiarism: is claiming the work someone else did, as work you did. DO NOT DO IT!!!! If you claim that you created the work someone else created, you will not pass the course.

assessments.Grading Guide: Student will create a model by using Polygon Primitives in Maya. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will create a firework scene using particle system in Maya Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will create a model by using Polygonal Modeling Tools in Maya. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will create a character based on provided model sheet. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will model a Car Wheel using NURBS method. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will make texture for the character in assignment 3. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will create an underwater enviroment using Paint Effects tool in Maya. The reference image will be provided. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities

Student will set-up lighting for the underwater enviroment created in assigment #6. The final result will be render out as image format (png/jpg/tga) Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will rig the model that created in assigment #5. Final rig should including skeleton, controls and succeed binding. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
Student will animate an action for the rig that created in assigment #8. Grading is based on performance in assessment tasks / activities
